corrected_fields.summary: MidCap Financial Investment Corporation (MFIC), a Business Development Company (BDC) listed on NASDAQ, filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing that Howard Widra will resign as director and Executive Chairman effective at the close of business on June 18, 2026. Widra, who is retiring from Apollo Global Management Inc., will not stand for re-election at the 2026 annual stockholders meeting. The filing states the departure is not due to disagreement with the company.
